Before I give final legal approval on the rollout conditions, I need to hear from each of you — privacy, labor, and information-security counsel. Please give me your verbal sign-off or flag any conditions or concerns you have. Let's start with privacy.

transcript.text: Before I give my sign-off, I need to flag a critical condition. I reviewed the current employee roster and state-law matrix this week and confirmed that exactly 620 Illinois employees will be enrolled in the voice-authentication system. Illinois biometric law — BIPA — requires written opt-in consent before collecting their voiceprints and also requires the company to publish a retention schedule. Neither of these points is in the rollout approval memo. I cannot sign off until we commit to obtaining written opt-in consent from all Illinois employees and publishing a retention schedule.
